steps.action: Prepare staff: invite a Legal Team Member who sets a password, and two colleagues who stay invited
steps.expected: Rows exist with the expected status

steps.action: Open Settings, Security, Authentication: two policy cards with four switches; SSO unavailable before a provider is registered
steps.expected: Legal User Authentication and Business Portal Authentication cards; Single sign-on (SSO) disabled
steps.actual: Settings rail Security expanded to Authentication. Switches: {"Legal User Authentication":["Email and password:true","Email magic link:true","Single sign-on (SSO):false:disabled","Require two-factor authentication:false"],"Business Portal Authentication":["Email and password:true","Email magic link:true","Single sign-on (SSO):false:disabled","Require two-factor authentication:false"]}.

steps.action: Allowed email domains: Add an approved domain and check the saved list
steps.actual: The empty list read "No domains allowed yet. Magic-link sign-in is unavailable." After Add, northwind.example appeared with a "Remove northwind.example" control and stayed after reload (["northwind.example"]).

steps.action: A policy with no sign-in method is refused
steps.expected: Enable at least one sign-in method.
steps.actual: Turning off Email magic link showed "Saved". Turning off Email and password as the last method showed "Enable at least one sign-in method." and the stored Legal policy kept password on. Email magic link was turned back on ("Saved").

steps.action: Emergency password sign-in: Email and password off under Legal User Authentication
steps.expected: An Administrator with a password still signs in; a Legal Team Member cannot
steps.actual: With Email and password off ("Saved"), the Administrator signed in with a password (me 200, role administrator). The Legal Team Member with a password was refused (Password sign-in is disabled for this account.; me 401). Email and password was turned back on.

steps.action: Email magic link under Legal User Authentication: existing staff get a link even when their domain is not allowed
steps.expected: Staff on helix.example and elsewhere.example receive links; an invited staff row stays Invited after magic-link sign-in
steps.actual: Allowed domains held only northwind.example. doc029-auth-legal@helix.example: link received, me 200 role legal_team_member; doc029-auth-staff@elsewhere.example: link received, me 200 role legal_team_member. The off-domain colleague's row still read Invited after the magic-link sign-in.

steps.action: New Portal entrant on an allowed domain gets a link; an unapproved address gets no link or password setup link
steps.expected: Allowed address becomes a Business User; unapproved address gets no mail and no account
steps.actual: doc029-auth-portal-mu4f8v77@northwind.example got "Sign in to OpenLaw", opened the Portal and is a business_user. doc029-auth-unapproved-mu4f8v77@unlisted.example saw the neutral "Check your email" and password-setup confirmations, but Mailpit received 0 messages and no account exists.

steps.action: A Business User sets a password through the Portal password setup link and signs in with Email and password
steps.expected: Password setup email; password sign-in reaches the Portal
steps.actual: "Set your OpenLaw password" arrived, the password was set, and Email and password sign-in on the Portal page reached /portal/onboarding as business_user.

steps.action: Remove the domain: no new links for anyone on it, but existing access continues as the article describes
steps.expected: Existing Business User gets no new link; held session, earlier link, and password sign-in still work; new-address setup refused at completion; staff unaffected
steps.actual: After Remove northwind.example the list read "No domains allowed yet...". Observed: {"newLinkMails":0,"heldSession":200,"earlierLink":"/portal/onboarding me 200","passwordSignIn":"me 200 business_user","lateCompletion":"OpenLaw Legal Portal Set your password At least 8 characters. Password setup is no longer available for this address. New password Confirm password Set password Help with this page","staffLink":true,"lateAccount":false}. The domain was added back.

steps.action: Turn off Email magic link under Business Portal Authentication: earlier links stop working and the Portal page offers other methods
steps.expected: Earlier link refused; no magic-link choice on the Portal page; password sign-in still works
steps.actual: Turning off Email magic link showed "Saved". Opening the link sent before the change stayed on /api/auth/magic-link/verify, which answered "{"message":"This sign-in method is disabled for your account.","code":"SIGN_IN_METHOD_DISABLED"}", with no session (me 401). The Portal sign-in page offered ["Sign in","Set up or reset your password"], with no magic-link choice. The Business User with a password still signed in (me 200). Email magic link was turned back on.
